# TildaZ v0.10.8

**Faster output on macOS and `Shift+Insert` paste.**

- macOS: large outputs are processed 19–67% faster. ([#839](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/839))
- `Shift+Insert` pastes, as in most terminals — the last mouse selection on Linux, the clipboard on Windows. ([#831](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/831))
- macOS: the one-line installer and uninstaller no longer touch a TildaZ installed with Homebrew. ([#833](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/833))

## Upgrade notes

- **GNOME · Cinnamon:** the TildaZ Shell extension has a new ID (`tildaz@tildaz.dev`). TildaZ removes the old one on first start. On GNOME, log out and back in after upgrading to load the new extension. ([#830](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/830))
- New `[keys]` action `paste_selection` (`Shift+Insert` on Linux and Windows). Your config does not have it yet, so the startup notice lists it until you add it. ([#831](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/831))

| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.10.8-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh --release`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.10.8-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.10.8-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.10.8-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.10.8-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 15+ universal | `tildaz-v0.10.8-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.10.8-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.10.8-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
